articles.title: Ocupação hoteleira em Natal deve atingir 83% no feriado | G1
articles.standfirst: Previsão da ABIH-RN representa aumento de oito pontos percentuais em relação ao feriado de Finados. Para o estado, estimativa é de 81% de ocupação.
articles.summary: A ocupação hoteleira em Natal deve crescer oito pontos percentuais em relação ao último feriado, impulsionada pela folga da Consciência Negra nesta sexta-feira.
articles.body:
No Rio Grande do Norte, a estimativa de ocupação hoteleira é de 81% — Foto: Magnus Nascimento/Prefeitura de Natal

A rede hoteleira de Natal deve alcançar 83% de ocupação durante o feriado da Consciência Negra, celebrado nesta sexta-feira (20). A estimativa é da Associação Brasileira da Indústria de Hotéis do Rio Grande do Norte (ABIH-RN), que prevê uma ocupação média de 81% em todo o estado.

A previsão para a capital representa um aumento de oito pontos percentuais em relação ao feriado de Finados, celebrado em 2 de novembro. No Rio Grande do Norte, a alta estimada é de quatro pontos percentuais.

A pesquisa foi feita com os associados da ABIH-RN. Para o mês de novembro, a entidade projeta uma ocupação média de 72% nos hotéis de Natal e de 67% na rede hoteleira estadual.

O secretário municipal de Turismo, Sanclair Solon, destacou que o feriado em uma sexta-feira pode favorecer viagens de curta duração. Ele também apontou a possibilidade de maior movimentação turística fora dos meses tradicionalmente associados à alta temporada.

"Estamos muito felizes com essa projeção, que também indica a possibilidade de maior movimentação turística fora dos meses tradicionalmente associados à alta temporada", disse Solon.

Para o verão, companhias aéreas preveem novas ligações com Natal. A Azul deve operar voos diretos entre a capital potiguar e Goiânia (GO) e Curitiba (PR), entre dezembro deste ano e janeiro de 2027.

No mercado internacional, a Latam programou três voos diretos por semana entre Natal e Buenos Aires, na Argentina, de 15 de dezembro a 28 de fevereiro.

A Gol e a JetSMART já operam ligações entre Natal e a capital argentina. A Gol também prevê retomar a rota direta entre Natal e Montevidéu, no Uruguai, com um voo semanal durante o verão.

articles.title: Racism row! AIFF approaches AFC over Palestine player's alleged gesture towards India captain
articles.summary: The All India Football Federation (AIFF) has filed a complaint with the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) over an alleged racist gesture by a Palestine
articles.body: The All India Football Federation (AIFF) has filed a complaint with the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) over an alleged racist gesture by a Palestine player towards India U17 men's team captain Dallalmuon Gangte during their AFC U17 Asian Cup Qualifier match in Kuala Lumpur.India defeated Palestine 4-1 on Tuesday to remain unbeaten in Group E of the qualifiers for the 2027 Asian Cup. The match was played in heavy rain, but the result was overshadowed by the alleged incident involving Palestine midfielder Soueidan and Gangte."The All India Football Federation (AIFF) has formally lodged a complaint with the Asian Football Federation (AFC) regarding an alleged racist gesture made by a Palestine player towards India U17 men's team captain Dallalmuon Gangte during the AFC U17 Asian Cup 2027 Qualifiers match between India and Palestine on November 17, 2026 at the Kuala Lumpur Football Stadium," the national federation said in a statement.AFC U17 Asian Cup Qualifier: What happened during the match?The incident reportedly took place in first-half stoppage time. Soueidan allegedly waved his hand in front of his nose near Gangte. The gesture was interpreted by several viewers and commentators as a racist stereotype suggesting an unpleasant smell.An angry Gangte confronted the Palestinian player on the pitch. Match referee Ko Minkuk intervened to separate the two players and warned both of them.The match also saw another disciplinary incident. Palestine midfielder Mohammed Jamhour was shown a straight red card in the first half for kicking Indian player Raj Singh Wahengbam twice.AIFF asks AFC to review incidentIn its complaint, the AIFF has asked the continental governing body to look into the incident and take necessary action.The federation has asked the AFC to "review the incident, examine the available match footage, and take appropriate action under the applicable regulations," it said in a statement posted on X.The AIFF also made its stand clear on discrimination in football.The federation said it "considers any form of racism and discriminatory behaviour extremely serious"."Such conduct is contrary to fundamental values of football, which are built on respect, equality, fair play and sportsmanship. There is no place for racism or discrimination in the game, and such behaviour must not be accepted or tolerated," the AIFF reiterated.India remain unbeaten after 4-1 winOn the field, India continued their unbeaten run in Group E with a convincing 4-1 victory over Palestine.Kamgouhao Doungel opened the scoring for the Mehrajuddin Wadoo-coached side in the eighth minute. Palestine captain Yazan Khalifah converted a penalty in the 32nd minute to level the score before the teams went into the break at 1-1.India took control in the second half despite the rain delay. Mukundo Singh Ningthoujam put them ahead in the 52nd minute, before captain Dallalmoun Gangte made it 3-1 in the 59th minute. Zoramdinthara Lalhunmawia added the fourth goal in the 89th minute to seal the win.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: España se medirá a un 'peso pesado' en cuartos de la Nations League
articles.standfirst: Alemania, Francia o Portugal serán el rival de la Selección en el sorteo de este viernes
articles.summary: Alemania, Francia o Portugal serán el rival de la Selección en el sorteo de este viernes
articles.body: La Selección española conoce ya gran parte del camino que le espera en la Nations League. Después de la derrota en el Metropolitano ante Inglaterra (2-3) obliga a los nuestros a enfrentarse a todo un 'peso pesado' en los cuartos de final. El próximo viernes 20 de noviembre, a las 12:00 horas, la sede de la UEFA en Nyon acogerá el sorteo oficial que deparará el emparejamiento para los de Luis de la Fuente. Las selecciones de Alemania, Francia y Portugal se han confirmado como los tres temibles contrincantes a los que se medirá la Roja en esta ronda. Alemania y Francia alcanzaron esta fase tras dominar con autoridad sus respectivos grupos, mientras que Portugal certificó su primera plaza en la última jornada tras superar a Gales. Este trío de gigantes europeos pondrá a prueba las aspiraciones del conjunto español en la competición continental. Los partidos de esta eliminatoria de cuartos de final a doble encuentro se disputarán los días 25 y 30 de marzo de 2027 y España jugará la ida en casa, en Mestalla, y la vuelta fuera. Los cuatro vencedores de esta ronda lograrán el billete definitivo para acceder a la ansiada Final Four, prevista entre el 9 y el 13 de junio.

articles.title: Sarina Wiegman lays down gauntlet to England players looking to make World Cup squad - but whose spot is under threat?
articles.summary: Sarina Wiegman made her England team selections for the World Cup play-off matches with Ukraine; Izzy Goodwin was picked for the first time in a forward talent that includes Aggie Beever-Jones and Michelle Agyemang; Ella Toone is back but does that mean Grace Clinton is in trouble?
articles.body:
The Lionesses head coach has again called up emerging players, this time for the playoffs against Ukraine, with the intention of creating a battle to make her final 26 next summer.

Izzy Goodwin is the latest youth international to get a senior call-up, following Lexi Potter, Erica Meg Parkinson and Freya Godfrey who all got their first caps in the previous round against Greece.

The London City Lionesses striker was a problem on Sunday for an Arsenal back-four packed with stars, including Leah Williamson .

The England captain was beaten by Goodwin when she scored the equaliser, a performance Wiegman admits helped her cause.

The backup for Alessia Russo will be one of the most-talked about battles if and when England decide who's going to Brazil.

Aggie Beever-Jones has also been recalled and Euros standout Michelle Agyemang is making her way back to full fitness.

One player that has passed selection test, however, is Ella Toone .

Wiegman has been thoroughly impressed with how the Manchester United midfielder reacted to being dropped last month.

Toone took herself off to Spain for an individual training camp and made sure she was in the best condition possible if Wiegman needed her as injury cover.

The back-to-back Euros winner has since improved her form for her club and is likely to add to her 69 caps in the next couple of weeks.

Toone's revival means another big name could fail to make the cut. Grace Clinton is back in the squad this time around but appears to be behind Toone, Potter, Keira Walsh and Georgia Stanway in the pecking order.

Laura Blindkilde Brown and Lucia Kendall have both started games recently too, which means Clinton has to heavily impress for both club and country before June.

The left-back spot is also up for grabs, especially with Niamh Charles and Alex Greenwood out through injury.

Can either of the recalled Poppy Pattinson or Taylor Hinds make a big enough push to oust a senior player?

Wiegman will be hoping these games against Ukraine give her a lot to think about as well as secure England's place at the World Cup next year.

articles.title: Man Utd boss Mauricio Pochettino says Manchester won't always be blue
articles.summary: New Manchester United boss Mauricio Pochettino says he will restore Manchester United to being the most successful footballing side in the city.
articles.body:
Mauricio Pochettino has said he will restore Manchester United to being the most successful football club in the city.

The Argentine is scheduled to begin his new role as United manager on Wednesday after agreeing a two-and-a-half-year contract.

The United States beat Haiti 2-0 in Cincinnati in his final game in charge on Tuesday, after which he spoke to TNT Sports. , external

Analyst DaMarcus Beasley, who spent the 2006-07 season on loan with Manchester City, joked that "Manchester is blue, it will always be blue".

Pochettino replied: "No way, you will see. Give me time and that is going to change."

The former Chelsea, Tottenham and Southampton boss flew directly to Manchester on a private jet after the game and landed at around 11:30 GMT before heading to the club's Carrington training ground.

"We're excited because the new challenge is big, but it's the adrenaline that you want to feel," he said.

"We are going to have a different job but we have the experience to deal with that. We need to add our common sense in the way that we are going to approach all the things.

"We know that it is not a situation that deserves to be at a club like Manchester United and for the fanbase."

Tuesday's win ensured the US advanced to the Concacaf Nations League semi-finals and that Pochettino finished with a 62.16% win ratio from 37 games in charge.

The 54-year-old led the team to the 2025 Gold Cup final and the last 16 of the 2026 World Cup, when the US were co-hosts.

"I am proud of what we achieved," he said in a statement on Instagram. , external

"When we arrived, I wanted us to believe that we could compete with anyone. I hope today that belief is stronger, not only with the players but with everyone who supports this team.

"This experience has re-energised me and given me so much, both in football and personally.

"Leaving is tough at this moment, but sometimes in football an opportunity comes that is impossible to say no to. I have always believed in following my heart, even when it means leaving a place where I have been very happy.

"I hope this team continues to grow and achieves all the success it deserves."

articles.title: Juan Mata cuelga las botas: "A veces, amar es dejar ir... Gracias, fútbol"
articles.standfirst: El futbolista español decide retirarse después de una carrera repleta de éxitos
articles.summary: El futbolista español decide retirarse después de una carrera repleta de éxitos
articles.body: Juan Mata cuelga las botas. El veterano futbolista decide poner fin a su carrera deportiva a los 38 años y después de dos décadas de carrera. El jugador colgó un vídeo para anunciar su decisión: "A veces, amar es dejar ir... Gracias fútbol". Así anunció Mata su adiós a la que ha sido su pasión durante toda su vida. Con una carrera que ha durado 20 años, el atacante se despide del mundo del fútbol. Llegó a la élite en 2006 de la mano del Real Madrid Castilla y se va siendo el mejor jugador de la liga australiana la temporada pasada. Entre es inicio y ese final, la carrera de Mata estuvo marcada por su paso por el Valencia, el Chelsea, el Manchester United, el Galatasaray, el Vissel Kobe y el Western Sydney. España, Inglaterra, Turquía, Japón y Australia son territorios conquistados por un futbolista que siempre ha sido querido dentro y fuera del terreno de juego. En su legado brilla un palmarés espectacular: una Champions League, dos Europa League, dos FA Cup, una Copa del Rey, una EFL Cup, una Community Shield y títulos de Liga en Turquía y Japón, además de reconocimientos individuales y, por supuesto, la Selección Española, con la que conquistó un Mundial, una Eurocopa y los Europeos sub-21 y sub-19, y la participación en los Juegos Olímpicos de Londres 2012. Mata se va después de disputar más de 700 partidos de fútbol, anotar 158 goles y repartir 175 asistencias. “Han sido tantos años gracias al disfrute por el juego. A levantarme cada mañana con ganas de entrenar, de jugar, bien sea en escenarios magníficos como Old Trafford, Stamford Bridge o Mestalla… o en mis comienzos en el Juventud Estadio, donde el campo se convertía en un barrizal cada invierno. Pienso que esa pasión es fundamental para todo en la vida”, dijo el jugador en su despedida. Pero no todo fue fútbol. Mata fundó el movimiento Common Goal y colaboró con muchas iniciativas: “Con el tiempo me di cuenta de que el fútbol no solo era darle patadas a un balón. Conforme fui creciendo, viajando y viviendo en diferentes países, comprendí la importancia que tiene el deporte en general, y el fútbol en concreto, para cambiar la vida de las personas”. Ahora no sabe qué hará, pero tiene seguro que seguirá ligado a este mundo: "El fútbol no se va a ir de mi vida. Hay muchas maneras de seguir amando el fútbol, maneras de seguir utilizándolo como vehículo de desarrollo. Puedo dejar de jugar profesionalmente, pero nunca voy a dejar de ser futbolista”.

Based on an initial look at the schedule, it would be tempting to say Week 12 is a lighter slate around college football.

Sure, there are a limited number of marquee tilts. Georgia's trip to South Carolina is the only Top 25 matchup on the docket as several SEC contenders are playing their typical late-November game against a nonconference foe.

articles.title: Juan Mata: Former Spain midfielder retires aged 38
articles.summary: Former Spain midfielder Juan Mata, who had spells at Chelsea and Manchester United in the Premier League, announces his retirement from playing at the age of 38.
articles.body:
Former Spain midfielder Juan Mata has announced his retirement from playing at the age of 38.

Mata, who made 41 international appearances, was part of the Spain squad that won the 2010 World Cup, and he helped his country win the European Championship two years later when he scored in the 4-0 final victory against Italy.

A former Real Madrid youth player, he joined Valencia in 2007 before a move to Chelsea in August 2011 where he won the Champions League, Europa League and FA Cup.

Mata moved to Manchester United in January 2014 and helped them claim the Europa League, FA Cup and League Cup prior to his departure in 2022.

He went on to have spells at Turkish side Galatasaray and Vissel Kobe in Japan before he played for Australian sides Western Sydney Wanderers and Melbourne Victory.

"Football will never leave my life," said Mata. "There are so many ways to continue loving the game, so many ways to keep using it as a vehicle for development.

"I may stop playing professionally, but I will never stop being a footballer."

Mata was Chelsea's player of the year in both full seasons he was at Stamford Bridge. He made 82 league appearances for the club, scoring 18 goals.

"What a player," Chelsea posted on social media.

At Manchester United, he scored 51 goals in 285 outings before leaving after his contract expired.

"Congratulations on a fantastic career, Juan! Everyone at United wishes you all the best in your next steps," said United statement. , external

articles.title: Selecciones post-ídolos: del tormento a la euforia
articles.standfirst: Argentina y Portugal comprueban lo que es la vida sin Messi y Cristiano Ronaldo; Brasil tardó 24 años en ganar un Mundial sin Pelé; la albiceleste, 36 sin Maradona...
articles.summary: Argentina y Portugal comprueban lo que es la vida sin Messi y Cristiano Ronaldo; Brasil tardó 24 años en ganar un Mundial sin Pelé; la albiceleste, 36 sin Maradona...
articles.body: Argentina y Portugal exploran un nuevo territorio, el de jugar sin los ídolos que los han fortalecido durante los últimos 20 años. Messi ya no lleva el '10' de la albiceleste y Cristiano Ronaldo no luce el '7' de Portugal. El tiempo medirá la huella de sus ausencias. Antes que a ellos les tocó el turno a otros dioses del fútbol como Pelé, Maradona, Beckenbauer, Ronaldo, Cruyff o Zidane. Unas selecciones lo notaron y otras flotaron. Argentina prueba estos días cómo es la vida sin Messi, escudo de la victoria en el Mundial de 2022. En el primer partido de la nueva era La Bombonera no se llenó contra Uruguay. La despedida del argentino se produjo el 6 de octubre contra Benin en el Monumental de Buenos Aires. Un rival de poca monta y una ceremonia espectacular. La albiceleste venció por 3-0 y el último gol fue de Messi de penalti, anticipo de la marea de emociones y lágrimas que se desencadenó al final del encuentro. A Scaloni le toca la labor de construir un equipo sin el futbolista que marcaba la diferencia. Como si sus carreras estuvieran conectadas por un hilo invisible, Cristiano Ronaldo también ha abandonado su selección en este otoño. Sin embargo, el guion del adiós del '7' ha sido una revuelta de capítulos. Sus últimos minutos los jugó el 24 de septiembre en el partido de la Liga de las Naciones ante Gales (1-0) disputado en el José Alvalade lisboeta. Nada hacía presagiar que se abría un volcán. Tres días después, Jorge Jesús le dejaba en el banquillo en la visita a Noruega. La detonación fue que Cristiano calentó sin que el seleccionador le diera entrada en el césped. El suceso desembocó en la marcha de Cristiano de la concentración de la selección portuguesa. Las siguientes semanas fueron una verbena de reacciones por todos los frentes. La Federación, asustada ante las brasas, le sancionó con 30 días y 255 euros. El 5 de noviembre Cristiano anunciaba su adiós a la selección portuguesa. "Es hora de devolver el número 7, nunca fue exclusivamente mío". Portugal preparó un homenaje para su estrella el pasado fin de semana, acto que quedó deslucido porque CR7 no asistió. Para continuar el culebrón, su madre, Dolores Aveiro arremetió contra el seleccionador Jorge Jesús. Con Cristiano Ronaldo Portugal conquistó la Eurocopa de 2016, su gran triunfo en toda la historia. Pelé dejó a la selección brasileña tras la disputa de cuatro Mundiales con tres títulos, aunque su presencia en el del 62 fue reducida por una lesión. O'Rei eligió Maracaná para su último partido con Brasil. El visitante, Yugoslavia, era una potencia aquel 18 de julio de 1971. Pelé jugó la primera parte en un choque que terminó en un 2-2. El '10' más grande de la historia brasileña aguantó las presiones para que volviera a la selección para la disputa del Mundial de 1974 en Alemania. En ese tiempo, Pelé ya estaba más ocupado en la publicidad y en la vida que le esperaba en el Cosmos. La huella de Pelé tardó en cubrirse. Brasil no volvió a ganar un Mundial hasta 1994, 24 años de sequía, un periodo torturador para la afición brasileña. El adiós de Maradona fue tan especial como su carrera. El corte llegó sin previo aviso y con un estrépito mundial. Argentina jugaba contra Nigeria el 25 de junio de 1994 en Boston en la primera fase de la cita mundialista. La victoria fue para la albiceleste por 2-1, una anécdota para lo que surgió después. Unos días más tarde se anunciaba el dopaje de Maradona, un terremoto planetario. Para Argentina fue imposible sacudirse el golpe de la expulsión del Mundial del mito. Nunca más volvió a vestir la camiseta con la que más gozó y lloró. Argentina, desde ese día, tardó 28 años en volver a ganar un Mundial, 36 si se rebobina hasta el 86. El desquite llegó en 2022, con Messi, la fotocopia más fidedigna del inolvidable barrilete cósmico. Cruyff, figura bíblica del fútbol holandés, tampoco disfrutó de un partido de despedida porque su adiós, que tampoco fue anunciado, se debió a un episodio de crónica de sucesos. El 26 de octubre de 1977, en el Olímpico de Amsterdam, Holanda ganó por 12-0 a Bélgica. No se podía sospechar que iba a ser la última vez que se vería a Cruyff con la elástica naranja. La causa de todo es que en septiembre Cruyff, acompañado de su esposa y su hija, sufrió un asalto en su casa barcelonesa, lo que suponía un intento de secuestro. Un individuo entró con una escopeta y llegó a atar al futbolista y encañonar a su familia. El fútbolista tardó años en admitir que el motivo por el que renunció fue la seguridad y protección de su familia después de prometer a Danny, su esposa, que no la volvería a dejar sola para un viaje mundialista. La conmoción en Holanda cuando Cruyff anunció su adiós fue tremenda. Se llegaron a recoger casi 50.000 firmas para que cambiara de opinión. Todo fue inútil. Sin Cruyff, Holanda llegó a la final del 78 y la volvió a perder. Diez años después, en 1988, los de naranja obtuvieron el mayor logro de su historia al conquistar la Eurocopa de Alemania. El ruido de un concierto heavy acompañó el último partido de Zidane con Francia. El futbolista había anunciado su retirada del fútbol cuando terminara el Mundial de 2006 en Alemania. El hecho se retrasó porque la selección gala llegó hasta la final, disputada el 9 de julio en Berlín ante Italia. Zidane abrió el marcador con un penalti a lo Panenka que se fue al larguero antes de botar dentro de la portería defendida por Buffon. El partido transcurría por la prórroga cuando Zidane, en un arrebato, cabeceó el pecho de Materazzi. El mundo, asombrado, no se explicaba lo sucedido. Después se supo que el italiano había insultado a la hermana de la estrella de Francia. Francia perdió la final en la tanda de penaltis y Zidane protagonizó una despedida abrupta. La FIFA le sancionó con tres partidos, que por su retirada se transformaron en trabajos relacionados con el fomento del fútbol en los niños. 12 años después, Francia ganó el Mundial de 2012. El 7 de junio de 2011 en el estadio Pacaembú de Sao Paulo fue la fecha escogida por Ronaldo para el último encuentro con Brasil. El Fenómeno había llenado las calles del país en 2002 al ser el referente del grupo que conquistó la cita mundialista de Japón y Corea. En Sao Paulo el rival fue Rumanía, que cayó por 1-0. Ronaldo sólo disputó el último cuarto de hora de la primera mitad. Ante el delirio de la hinchada, el goleador se llevó hasta el balón y el silbato del encuentro. La fiesta no fue completa porque Ronaldo no aprovechó tres ocasiones claras: "Perdonen, no he aprovechado tres oportunidades". Brasil se ha quedado en cinco Mundiales, el último fue el conquistado con Ronaldo hace 24 años. Un adiós que todavía se nota. Habrá que esperar cómo se notan las retiradas de Messi y Cristiano. Se admiten adivinos.

articles.title: Rüdiger: "¿Debo decirle a un jugador que ha marcado 100 goles en dos años que haga mi trabajo? Eso no tiene sentido"
articles.standfirst: El central del Real Madrid se sincera en una entrevista con The Athletic
articles.summary: El central del Real Madrid se sincera en una entrevista con The Athletic
articles.body: Antonio Rüdiger concedió una entrevista a The Athletic en la que repasa su trayectoria en el Real Madrid, habla de lo que pesan dos años sin títulos en el club blanco ("Es horrible", asegura), de su relación con José Mourinho y del reparto de roles en la plantilla del equipo blanco. "¿Debe decirle a un jugador que ha marcado 100 goles en dos años que haga mi trabajo? Eso no tiene sentido", comenta en relación a los comentarios sobre la no implicación defensiva de jugadores como Kylian Mbappé. “Me llamó poco antes del final de la temporada para decirme que iba a ser el entrenador. Quería que me quedara, así que todo estaba bastante claro. Ha habido muchas veces que me ha querdio. Por ejemplo, cuando estaba en el Tottenham y yo no estaba jugando mucho en el Chelsea con Lampard. Y también cuando era más joven. Hay una historia entre nosotros, y al final, a los 33 años, nos hemos encontrado". “No diría que ha hecho muchos cambios. Encontró un equipo que tiene buen equilibrio. Él sabe hacer equipos de éxito, y eso es lo que ha hecho. No importa quién empieza o quién sale del banquillo. Gasta bromas, pero sólo en el vestuario. Cuando llega por las mañanas, siempre tiene una hstoria que contar. Pero en el campo no hay bromas" "¿Debe decirle a un jugador que ha marcado 100 goles en dos años que haga mi trabajo? Eso no tiene sentido. Hay que mirar la historia. ¿Cómo fue cuando Gareth Bale, Benzema y Cristiano Ronaldo estaban aquí? Mirad el éxito que tuvieron. No tenemos que estar siempre hablando de cómo defienden". “Así es la historia del Real Madrid. Si miras al pasado, entrenadores como Lopetegui o Benitez tuvieron algún problema con esto, pero el Madrid siempre fue un grupo de estrellas, siempre grandes personajes del fútbol. Así que sí, no es sólo un mito. Es la realidad". “Son emociones, aunque obviamente he reflexionado sobre ello, porque normalmente no estoy 'loco' de esa manera, de forma negativa. Soy una persona y asumo mis responsabilidades. Levanto la mano, y personalmente me disculpé con los árbitros, porque tuvimos ocasión de vernos después, y a partir de ahí seguimos adelante. Soy un ser humano que cometió un error, y lo asumo".

articles.title: Amina Muratović, la fan del Barça ante el que se mide sin complejos: "No tenemos nada que perder"
articles.standfirst: La internacional suiza atiende a MARCA antes del duelo de Champions en el Johan Cruyff
articles.summary: La internacional suiza atiende a MARCA antes del duelo de Champions en el Johan Cruyff
articles.body: El Servette se medirá este jueves (21:00 horas) en Barcelona al vigente campeón de Europa en la presente jornada de la Women’s Champions League. Una de las mejores jugadoras del conjunto suizo es la internacional Amina Muratović. La central de veinte años es una de las elegidas por Rafel Navarro para dos partidos claves contra Austria donde Suiza se juega la clasificación para el Mundial de Brasil. La defensora atiende a MARCA antes de vivir unas semanas tan ilusionantes como importantes en su carrera profesional. Amina es consciente de lo mucho que ha trabajado su equipo para poder llegar a jugar partidos como el de este jueves. "Sabíamos que no iba a ser fácil jugar la Champions. Pero estábamos preparadas para hacerlo, creo que lo merecemos porque es un trabajo que lo llevamos haciendo desde hace mucho tiempo", apuntó la central, que fija un momento importante para la historia del club cuando lograron la primera victoria en la máxima competición europea frente al OH Leuven. "Conseguir ganar un partido nos dio un feeling muy especial”, afirma. La defensora tiene muy claro cómo va a salir tanto ella como su equipo el jueves contra el campeón de Europa: "No tenemos nada que perder y mucho que ganar, tenemos que salir con todo, darlo todo e ir al cien por cien. Creo que es una experiencia muy buena más allá de lo que vaya a pasar porque es un equipo genial", revela. Amina destaca el grupo que conforma el Barça más allá de una jugaréis en particular. "Da igual que sea Patri Guijarro, Hansen, Claudia Pina… la verdad que todas son increíbles. Tenemos que tener cuidado con todas”, declaró. La internacional se declara fan de su próximo rival desde que tenía cuatro años cuando veía los partidos con su padre. "Soy fan del Barça desde que era pequeña, desde que tenía cuatro años. Mi padre veía mucho los partidos del Barça y yo me hice fan por eso”. Por este motivo tiene muy claro a qué equipo tendrá delante el próximo jueves: “El Barça todos sabemos lo que es, es un equipo muy grande, para mí el mejor equipo del mundo", confiesa. Amina regresa a una convocaría con Suiza en un momento de esplendor en el fútbol de ese país. "Hay muchas jugadoras buenas. Tanto las más jóvenes como las las mayores. Tenemos jugadoras en todos los lados: en el Arsenal, Brighton, Barça… Creo que la selección lo está haciendo muy bien en los últimos años y estoy contenta por ello", asegura. Dentro de la mucha calidad que tiene el combinado suizo, la zaguera se queda con dos futbolistas por encima del resto: "La primera vez que fui ya vi a muchas que son muy buenas. Pero si me puedo quedar con dos diría a Sidney Schertenleib porque es una futbolista con muchas cualidades y con Lia Wälti". El fútbol en Suiza atraviesa su mejor momento y eso ilusiona mucho a un país que está volcado con su selección femenina. El envite ante Austria registrará una entrada historia donde se congregarán 17.366 personas. "Es increíble. Cuando se hizo la Eurocopa en Suiza era una locura la gente que iba a los partidos. Y ahora contra Austria jugamos en Berna y hay mucha gente que va a ir al partido. Es algo increíble", destacó. El seleccionador suizo es español, Rafel Navarro, que llegó al puesto después de formar parte del cuerpo técnico del Barça. Amina piensa que fue una elección acertada: "Es un entrenador muy bueno, sabe lo que quiere. Con las ideas claras y sabe cómo quiere que juguemos. El es muy claro con nosotras, trabaja mucho y nos aparta mucha información. La verdad que estoy muy contenta con él". La Suiza de Amina se medirá a España en la fase de grupos de la Nations League. La defensora ya se midió a España en categorías inferiores y ahora espera volver a hacerlo contra un equipo plagado de estrellas. "Me enfrenté a España con la Sub'19 hace dos años y ganamos 2-1. Si el Barça tiene jugadoras increíbles la selección española todavía más. Tienen a Alexia Putellas… Por mi parte tengo muchas ganas de recibir a este equipo en Suiza", rememora. Por último, el Servette anunció la pasada semana la marcha de su técnico, Cristian Toro en el próximo mes de diciembre por temas personales. Amina destaca la importancia que tuvo tanto a nivel personal como para el Servette como club. "Pienso que lo ha hecho muy bien en el Servette. Él lo ha ganado todo y estamos en la Champions, ha hecho lo máximo que podía hacer. Para mí es alguien que me ha dado mucho, jugaba el año pasado y estoy jugando este. Él me ha dado mucha confianza y gracias a eso fue a la primera convocatoria con la selección. Estoy muy agradecida a lo que ha hecho por mí", sentencia.

articles.title: El Barça hace pleno en los Premios LaLiga EA Sports 2025/26
articles.standfirst: Lamine Yamal, Flick y Joan Garcia se llevaron los principales galardones
articles.summary: Lamine Yamal, Flick y Joan Garcia se llevaron los principales galardones
articles.body: Lamine Yamal, Hansi Flick, Carlos Espí, Joan Garcia y Arda Güler son los ganadores de los Premios de LaLiga EA Sports 2025/26, tras ser reconocidos como "los protagonistas más destacados de la pasada temporada", según informó este miércoles la competición. El jugador del Barcelona, Lamine Yamal recibirá el premio al Mejor Jugador "tras completar la temporada con 16 goles y 12 asistencias", mientras que su técnico, el alemán Hansi Flick, recibirá el premio a Mejor Entrenador por llevar al equipo culé "a revalidar el campeonato con 94 puntos", se informó en un comunicado. También en representación del club catalán, Joan Garcia será galardonado con el premio a la Mejor Parada por su intervención en el derbi ante el RCD Espanyol tras competir en la candidatura con los guardametas del Atlético de Madrid, Jan Oblak, y del Athletic Club, Unai Simón, una temporada que el portero cierra con el Trofeo Zamora, tras encajar sólo 21 goles, continúa la nota. El premio a Mejor Jugador sub-23 reconoce al delantero Carlos Espí, actualmente en el Real Madrid, que en su debut en el fútbol de máxima categoría, "marcó once goles, diez de ellos en las últimas trece jornadas, que resultaron decisivos para la permanencia del Levante UD y le situaron entre los quince máximos goleadores de la competición". Por su parte, el futbolista del Real Madrid, Arda Güler recibirá el premio al Mejor Gol por su tanto en la jornada 28 ante el Elche CF en el estadio Santiago Bernabéu, añadió LaLiga. Los jugadores también figuran entre los nominados a los Globe Soccer Awards, con siete futbolistas candidatos a Mejor Jugador, entre ellos Lamine Yamal (FC Barcelona), Kylian Mbappé (Real Madrid CF), Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid CF) y Pau Cubarsí (FC Barcelona), además de otros jugadores nominados a mejor delantero, centrocampista, defensa, portero y jugador emergente, mientras que el FC Barcelona opta a Mejor Club Masculino y Hansi Flick a Mejor Entrenador. Los galardones se entregarán el 28 de diciembre en Emiratos Árabes Unidos en el marco de la 17.ª edición de los BEYOND Developments Globe Soccer Awards, en una gala que "reunirá a figuras del fútbol internacional y permitirá poner en valor, ante una audiencia global, la contribución de los premiados a una temporada en la que el FC Barcelona revalidó el título de LaLiga EA Sports" de la pasada temporada.

articles.title: Julián, del hundimiento... a un parón sanador
articles.standfirst: Ha marcado tres goles (uno a Uruguay y dos a Costa Rica) en una ventana de selecciones en la que ha tenido más acierto que en toda la campaña
articles.summary: Ha marcado tres goles (uno a Uruguay y dos a Costa Rica) en una ventana de selecciones en la que ha tenido más acierto que en toda la campaña
articles.body: Tres goles ha firmado Julián en el parón que selecciones. Tres goles en apenas 135 minutos (completó el choque ante Uruguay, apenas disputó 45 minutos frente a Costa Rica) para superar todos los tantos que lleva en la actual campaña: dos dianas ante Stuttgart y Deportivo. Una explosión goleadora más que necesaria para un futbolista que sigue en el camino de la redención por lo vivido durante el pasado verano. Su deseo de marcharse al Barça enturbió su paso por un Atlético que sabe, como afirma Simeone cada vez que le preguntan por su compatriota, que necesita la mejor versión versión de la Araña. Y más tras el evidente paso atrás protagonizado precisamente ante los de Flick en su último partido como rojiblanco. Con todo el foco puesto en su figura, la Araña desperdició dos ocasiones clarísimas que fueron afeadas por un Metropolitano que no acaba de perdonarle. Que disputara los 90 minutos le evitó una pitada, pero también despertó el malestar de parte del respetable. Acabados los partidos con Argentina, a Julián le toca regresar para reconducir su temporada como rojiblanco. En lo que queda de 2026 a los del Cholo le quedan nueve partidos (seis de Liga, dos de Champions y uno de Copa) para que el 19 se recomponga y vuelva a mostrar su versión de la temporada 24-25, en la que con 29 goles firmó la mejor temporada de su carrera. De momento, el parón le ha servido para tomar impulso… como necesitaba tras el partido ante el Barça.

articles.title: Man Utd transfer news: Calvin Bassey and Jarrad Branthwaite among targets with Mauricio Pochettino set to be backed in January
articles.summary: Watch our 'Unfinished Business' Transfer Show special on Sky Sports News at 4pm and 7pm as we look ahead to January; Man Utd are expected to be active in the market with left-back, centre-back and a forward on the agenda for new head coach Mauricio Pochettino
articles.body:
A left-back, centre-back and forward are areas the club are looking to potentially strengthen in January with Pochettino expected to have input on targets they will pursue.

Despite the club's hierarchy feeling the team should be further up the table, there is also an acknowledgement that they could have further strengthened the squad in the summer in areas where they lacked depth.

Sky Sports News understands Manchester United already had plans to move in the upcoming window under former head coach Michael Carrick, before he was sacked last month following United's worst start to a league season for 40 years.

However, Pochettino is now expected to be consulted in the coming weeks and will have his say on potential recruits in January.

Fulham's Calvin Bassey and Everton's Jarrad Branthwaite are two players United are monitoring as potential options to reinforce their defence in January.

Despite Fulham's struggles this season, Bassey is a player who has impressed and has just six months left on his current deal, though his club have the option to extend that by a further year.

Fulham head coach Alvaro Arbeloa has described the 26-year-old as one of the best defenders in the world and said the club's aim is to extend Bassey's contract.

Meanwhile, Branthwaite has long been admired by United. In 2024, United had two bids rejected for the centre-back, their second being worth around £50m.

Everton are in a strong negotiating position over the 24-year-old, who has a contract until the summer of 2030.

United are looking at left-footed centre-back options as they consider potential replacements for Lisandro Martinez. His future at Old Trafford looks in doubt come next summer with his current contract expiring.

Despite United having an option for a further 12 months, he is unlikely to be offered fresh terms as Sky Sports News reported last month.

The club decided not to pursue a left-back in the summer as they focused on their midfield rebuild with the belief their long-term targets would be more attainable next year.

It remains to be seen whether that will be true come the end of the season and where that leaves players such as Newcastle United's Lewis Hall, but with five different players being used in that position with limited success, the club will look at the possibility of cover at left-back in January.

Fulham left-back Antonee Robinson continues to be monitored, as first reported by Sky Sports News in March. Fulham are aware of widespread interest in Robinson but no club has so far made a move for the 29-year-old, who worked under Pochettino with the USA.

Barcelona's Alejandro Balde was a player linked with United in the summer but was never at a stage when the move seemed likely. United were aware of his potential availability and it has not been ruled out that they revisit a deal in January if it works for all parties.

Manchester City's Rayan Ait-Nouri was an option United tentatively explore on Deadline Day but they decided against pursuing him due to City's insistence on an obligation to make the move permanent. Sky Sports News understands he is not considered a target at this stage as United look at other options.

With United's main No 9 Benjamin Sesko ruled out until at least January, the club will explore potential reinforcements in the upcoming window to re-balance the club's attack.

Although United scored seven goals in their last two games before the break, the club have missed a physical presence in Sesko's absence to lead the line.

Leeds United's Dominic Calvert-Lewin was a player of interest but his future looks likely to remain at Elland Road and United are not expected to explore a move for the forward.

Any outgoings in January could have an impact on how much the club can reinforce Pochettino's squad but numerous first-team departures are not likely with the size of the squad and long-term injuries as well as Pochettino needing time to assess his squad all set to play a factor.

Joshua Zirkzee continues to be a player who attracts interest from Italy and United could entertain a move for the Dutch forward if they receive a suitable offer but would need cover in that position.

Martinez's future will under the spotlight in January. Sky Sports News reported last month United are unlikely to offer him a new contract. His current deal expires next summer although the club hold an option for a further 12 months.

Pochettino will also have to manage other expiring contracts in his squad with Harry Maguire, Luke Shaw and captain Bruno Fernandes also in the last six months of their current contracts, although it is worth noting the club have a 12-month option on Fernandes and Maguire.

articles.title: Ivan Toney loses bid to avoid Euro 2028 assault trial clash
articles.summary: Ivan Toney's trial, for an alleged assault which he denies, is due to take place during the Euro 2028 tournament.
articles.body:
A bid to move the date of England striker Ivan Toney's assault trial to avoid a clash with Euro 2028 has been refused.

The 30-year-old footballer, from Northampton, is accused of headbutting and punching Saber Da Silva during a confrontation at a nightclub in Wardour Street, central London, on 6 December.

Toney denied assault occasioning actual bodily harm at a court hearing last month and a date for a trial of up to four days was fixed for 12 June 2028, which is three days into the Uefa Euro 2028 tournament.

He represented England at this summer's World Cup and has made 10 international appearances. It is not yet known if he will be selected for Euro 2028, but the application was made in case.

At a hearing at Southwark Crown Court on Wednesday, where Toney did not appear, his barrister Mozammel Hossain KC said: "It came to our attention that… there may be potentially a football match called the European Championship in 2028 between 9 June and 9 July."

Hossain proposed a trial date in August that year, adding: "We ask you please that the matter be put back to then for a trial so that if the defendant is included in this football tournament he can play.

"My knowledge of football is very limited but I am told he was included in the last one in 2024 and the England squad for the World Cup."

Judge Tony Baumgartner called it a "speculative" application.

He refused the request, saying: "It does not seem to me to be in the interest of justice to disturb the date that was already fixed."

The judge said the application could be made again if Toney is selected for the England squad.

Toney missed out on the latest squad for the country's Nations League ties.

Toney started his football career with Northampton Town and played for teams including Wigan Athletic and Peterborough United before signing for Brentford in 2020.

He scored 72 goals during four years with the Bees before making a surprise switch in 2024 to Saudi Pro League club Al-Ahli.

articles.title: Puerta cerrada en el fútbol base ceutí ante la reiteración de insultos y violencia verbal
articles.standfirst: La Federación de Ceuta toma esta medida para los partidos de este fin de semana
articles.summary: La Federación de Ceuta toma esta medida para los partidos de este fin de semana
articles.body: Todos los encuentros de las competiciones territoriales de Ceuta, en sus distintas categorías y modalidades, programados para este fin de semana, se jugarán a puerta cerrada. Así lo ha acordado la Real Federación de Fútbol de Ceuta (RFFCE) tras constatar una preocupante sucesión de incidentes en los terrenos de juego. Según ha detallado el organismo presidido por Antonio García Gaona, el veto al público obedece a la "reiteración de episodios de violencia verbal, insultos, amenazas y comportamientos antideportivos en nuestras competiciones, que han obligado a activar en numerosas ocasiones el protocolo de actuación frente a la violencia". Antes de emitir el comunicado oficial, la cúpula federativa trasladó de primera mano la medida y sus motivos tanto a su Junta Directiva como a los coordinadores del fútbol base de los distintos clubes locales. El foco puesto en la protección de los menores La mayor inquietud de la territorial radica en el fútbol formativo, donde el comportamiento de ciertos adultos en las gradas golpea directamente a niños, niñas y colegiados jóvenes. La RFFCE lamenta que los deportistas tengan que competir en un clima viciado por las faltas de respeto y recuerda que "muchos de nuestros árbitros son menores de edad" reciben descalificaciones constantes. "El comportamiento de los adultos debe servirles de ejemplo, no transmitirles una imagen del deporte alejada de los valores que queremos enseñarles", advierte la entidad, que agradece la comprensión de los familiares y aficionados que sí mantienen una actitud ejemplar. Llamada a la reflexión y expedientes individualizados Aunque el cierre de las instalaciones supone un castigo colectivo pensado como una "llamada a la reflexión", la Federación subraya que no todas las responsabilidades son iguales. Por ello, trabaja ya en la identificación de los clubes, técnicos, jugadores o espectadores responsables de los altercados para adoptar actuaciones específicas contra ellos conforme a la normativa vigente. "Los insultos, las amenazas y las faltas de respeto no pueden convertirse en algo habitual en nuestras instalaciones", recalca el ente federativo. No es la primera vez que la RFFCE intenta ejecutar esta medida: ya anunció una jornada sin público a principios de diciembre del año pasado, aunque las condiciones meteorológicas obligaron entonces a suspender los partidos previstos. Casi un años después, la persistencia de estos comportamientos ha vuelto a forzar el cierre. Desde la territorial insisten en que el objetivo es recuperar "campos llenos de familias y aficionados que disfruten del fútbol y animen desde el respeto", pero avisan de que actuarán con firmeza y no dudarán en repetir o ampliar los cierres durante la temporada si la situación no mejora. "Un insulto desde la grada puede parecer algo pasajero para quien lo pronuncia, pero puede dejar una huella profunda en un niño que juega o en un joven árbitro que está aprendiendo. Nuestros niños y niñas merecen disfrutar del fútbol sin miedo, sin insultos y sin violencia", concluye el comunicado.

articles.title: Wayne Rooney reveals he would lock himself away and drink alone while 'contemplating taking his own life' during peak of Manchester United career
articles.summary: In a candid podcast interview, Wayne Rooney reveals his struggles with alcohol, mental health, and thoughts of suicide during the peak of his Manchester United career, highlighting the support of his wife Coleen.
articles.body: Wayne Rooney was scoring goals, winning trophies and approaching the peak of his career at Manchester United, but away from the pitch, he was struggling to cope with a life that appeared, from the outside, to be going exactly as he had hoped. The former England captain has now spoken about the drinking, isolation and mental health difficulties he kept hidden during those years, revealing that he reached a point where he contemplated suicide and sought help from a therapist. His account also explains how his wife, Coleen, helped him through a period he describes as the lowest of his life.The drinking and isolation behind Rooney’s best years at Manchester UnitedRooney has revealed that some of the darkest periods of his life coincided with what he regarded as the best years of his football career. Speaking to BBC presenter Gabby Logan on The Life at the Midpoint podcast, the former Manchester United and England forward described how he would spend days drinking alone at home, even as he continued to perform and score regularly for his club.Asked about the lowest point in his life, Rooney said he had not felt comfortable with adulthood until his mid-20s, when he eventually reached what he described as rock bottom.“Rock bottom was when I was drinking; I'd lock myself in the house for two days and just drink. This was at probably the best part of my career, playing-wise. I'd have a couple of days off, I'd go home and I'd sit in the games room, and I'd drink for two days. Then I'd get up in the morning, and I had training.”The routine became a cycle that was difficult for him to break. Rooney explained that scoring goals at the weekend made it easier to return to the same behaviour, because his performances on the pitch gave little indication of what was happening elsewhere in his life.“What didn't help me is, I'd score one or two goals at the weekend. So it was like a cycle, and I'd do it again. I couldn't deal with all the pressures of everything... the pressures of football, I think I was alright with. And I made stupid choices as well when I was younger, off the pitch. I really struggled to deal with it all, to be honest.”Rooney joined Manchester United from Everton in 2004 and went on to become the club's record goalscorer, with 253 goals in 559 appearances. He helped United win five Premier League titles, the Champions League, the Europa League, the FA Cup and three League Cups before returning to Everton in 2017. His achievements on the pitch, however, concealed the extent of his difficulties at the time.‘Contemplating suicide’: The point when Rooney knew he needed helpRooney said his struggles eventually reached a point where he no longer wanted to be around other people. He described avoiding the streets and shops, and retreating from ordinary social contact, even though he remained comfortable in the familiar environment of a football pitch.“I got to a place where you're contemplating suicide. I just didn't want to be around anyone. I didn't want to see people in the street, I didn't want to go into the shops... and I was always comfortable on a football pitch, training and playing on a football pitch. But everything else, I really struggled with.”The former England captain also explained why he found it difficult to acknowledge what was happening. He felt pressure to conceal his struggles, particularly because he believed admitting to them would make him appear weak.“You don't want to show any weakness, so you try to mask it. The position I was in, it was difficult to actually admit that I was in that position. I felt like I felt less a man, if you like, for doing it.”It was only after speaking openly with his wife, Coleen, and his mother that Rooney accepted he needed help. He said he had reached a point where keeping his difficulties to himself was no longer an option and began speaking to a therapist to understand what he was experiencing.“It was only when I spoke to Coleen [his wife], I spoke to my mum, and I opened up about it. Obviously, Coleen especially knew what was going on. But I vocally opened up and I knew I needed help to get through it.”Rooney also reflected on how difficult it was to reconcile those experiences with what was happening in his personal life. He had recently married Coleen and had become a father to their eldest son, Kai, who was a baby at the time. He believed he should have been enjoying one of the happiest periods of his life, but instead found himself struggling with his mental health and withdrawing from his family.“I was speaking to a therapist to try and figure out what was up with me because when I look back I was probably at the height of my career, I've just had a young son, I've just been married. It should be the happiest point in my life and it wasn't. It was probably the lowest point because of the selfish acts I was taking.”How Coleen helped him through the crisisRooney said he often isolated himself partly because he did not want his young son to see him drinking or in the state he was experiencing during those periods. Looking back, he acknowledged the time he lost and the effect his behaviour had on his family, while also explaining that he was struggling to understand and manage what was happening to him.“It's when you look back now, you look back with regret, because there's time lost. Kai was a baby at the time, and I can look back and say I was selfish but I knew I was going through something I was really struggling to deal with. I didn't want Kai seeing me like that, so that's why I'd hide away as well.”He credited Coleen with playing a decisive role in helping him recover, saying their relationship had come under considerable strain during the period. She could have left, he acknowledged, but instead stayed with him and helped him work through his difficulties.“Coleen helped me massively. She could have walked away, it was that bad. And she stuck by me, helped me get through, and we went on to have more kids.”Rooney said he stopped drinking for a period before returning to alcohol, although he stressed that his drinking did not return to the same level as before. His account did not present recovery as a single moment or a straightforward change, but as a process that involved recognising the problem, speaking about it and accepting support.The former forward also reflected on the pressure he felt to maintain an image of strength during his playing career. For a footballer operating at the highest level, he said, admitting that he was struggling was particularly difficult, even when his performances suggested that everything was under control.From Manchester United record scorer to life beyond footballRooney's admission comes years after the end of his playing career, during which he became one of the most prominent figures in English football. He scored 53 goals in 120 appearances for England and remains Manchester United's all-time leading goalscorer, having established himself as a central figure in the club's most successful modern period.After leaving Everton, Rooney continued playing in the United States with D.C. United before retiring from professional football in 2013? No — Rooney retired from playing in 2021, after a spell at Derby County, where he also began his managerial career. He subsequently managed Derby, D.C. United, Birmingham City and Plymouth Argyle, although those appointments brought a different set of professional challenges from the playing career that made him famous.He has since moved into broadcasting, working as a pundit for the BBC and Amazon Prime. He was also named Pundit of the Year at the Broadcast Sport Awards and is currently appearing on the 26th series of I'm a Celebrity... Get Me Out of Here! His wife Coleen competed on the programme two years earlier.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Joint-record six referee errors in last Premier League weekend
articles.summary: The Premier League's Key Match Incidents Panel rules there were six on-field errors in the last round of games - the joint-highest in one weekend.
articles.body:
The Premier League's Key Match Incidents Panel has ruled there were six on-field errors in the last round of games - the joint-highest it has recorded in one weekend.

Each week, the five members of the panel assess all the contentious incidents and vote whether both the referee and the video assistant referee (VAR) have got the decisions correct.

You have to go back to the early part of the 2023-24 season to find the last time there were six mistakes logged.

The statistic does not include correct VAR interventions to fix errors, such as the red card shown to Brentford 's Igor Thiago.

In the last round of games almost every fixture had a contentious refereeing situation which was hotly debated.

It started on Friday with a potential penalty to Coventry City for a hair pull by Everton 's James Tarkowski.

Arsenal were denied a penalty following a VAR review after it was deemed Kai Havertz was offside.

Tottenham lodged a complaint over a challenge by Leeds United 's Jayden Bogle, who was not shown a red card.

And Liverpool argued against a late Crystal Palace penalty.

But which decisions did the KMI Panel rule were incorrect? Some of the votes might surprise you.

Two decisions were on-field and VAR errors

Such was the controversy across the weekend, it may come as a surprise that the KMI Panel ruled only two were missed VAR interventions. There have been six missed overall, the same number as this stage last season.

Incident 1: Coventry 's Caleb Yirenkyi appeared to have his hair pulled inside the area by Everton 's James Tarkowski. No penalty was awarded.

KMI Panel vote: 5:0 incorrect, for the on-field decision and the VAR.

What the KMI Panel said: "Tarkowski had a hold of Yirenkyi's hair and the panel unanimously felt that VAR should have intervened."

Incident 2: Arsenal 's Kai Havertz was pulled down inside the area by Hull City 's Nobel Mendy. The VAR, Michael Oliver, sent referee Farai Hallam to the pitchside monitor but it was not given due to an offside offence by the Germany international.

What the KMI Panel said: "Although Harvertz is clearly in an offside position, there is a clear and impactful holding action by Mendy before any potential offside offence."

Four decisions were on-field errors, but not VAR mistakes

When the KMI Panel sits down to vote there are two separate considerations.

The first is on the decision of the referee, which is a basic judgement in law and the Premier League's expected interpretation.

The second is on the potential VAR intervention. This takes into account what the referee has said, the available replay angles and the high bar for intervention.

Incident 1: Thierno Barry put Everton in front against Coventry in the 61st minute, but there was a VAR check for a potential handball.

KMI Panel vote: 2:3 incorrect on the field, but 5:0 no VAR intervention.

What the KMI Panel said: "On the balance of probability the ball did accidentally strike Barry's hand. However, the readily available footage did not provide conclusive evidence."

Incident 2: Crystal Palace were awarded a penalty against Liverpool three minutes into stoppage time for a foul by Milos Kerkez on Dario Osorio. But was it just a clash of heads?

KMI Panel vote: 0:5 incorrect on the field, but 5:0 no VAR intervention.

What the KMI Panel said: "A penalty was incorrect with the contact being inevitable. However, it was not a clear and obvious error."

Incident 3: Ipswich were awarded a 72nd-minute penalty against Bournemouth for a foul by Lewis Cook on Abdoul Ouattara.

KMI Panel vote: 1:4 incorrect on the field, but 4:1 no VAR intervention.

What the KMI Panel said: "Ouattara made a clear step across Cook who didn't make a challenge and the referee's decision to award a penalty was incorrect. However, it was not a clear and obvious error."

Incident 4: Potential second yellow card for Bournemouth 's Marcus Tavernier.

KMI Panel vote: 2:3 incorrect on the field; no VAR intervention possible.

What the KMI Panel said: "There was a clear, deliberate action by Tavernier to delay the restart."

The controversial decisions deemed to be correct

Some of the most high-profile decisions from across the weekend have not yet featured.

That is because they have been voted to be correct on the field and through VAR.

Incident 1: Leeds United 's Jayden Bogle caught Tottenham 's Mathys Tel on high on his ankle. There was no VAR review for a red card.

KMI Panel vote: 3:2 correct on the field and for the VAR intervention.

What the KMI Panel said: "The majority felt Bogle was looking to challenge with his right leg and his left leg came down on the back of Tel's ankle without the speed, force or intensity to be serious foul play. Two panellists felt that the challenge was sufficiently dangerous to merit a red card."

Incident 2: Chelsea 's Cole Palmer went down on the edge of the area under a challenge by Sunderland 's Luke O'Nien.

KMI Panel vote: 4:1 correct on the field and for the VAR intervention.

What the KMI Panel said: "Clear contact made by O'Nien on Palmer which the panel felt should have been penalised with a free-kick on the basis that contact was made outside the area. One panellist felt that the foul contact was inside the area."

Incident 3: Sunderland were awarded a penalty when Levi Colwill was ruled to have tripped Brian Bobbey.

KMI Panel vote: 5:0 correct on the field and for the VAR intervention.

What the KMI Panel said: "There was upper body holding from both players as they progressed into the penalty area before a careless trip by the Chelsea defender."

Incident 4: Possible foul by Senne Lammens on Aston Villa goalkeeper Zion Suzuki before Patrick Dorgu's 96th-minute equaliser.

What the KMI Panel said: "Although Lammens turned away from the ball, the contact he made on Suzuki was not impactful."

The KMI Panel was scrapped this summer in the Scottish Premiership because clubs became frustrated with the voting patterns of its members.

But it is more important in the Premier League, with the results creating a merit table which contributes to 50% of referees' salaries in bonus payments.

Many fans will feel there should have been more than two VAR errors logged in the last round of games.

Yet the KMI Panel does not exist to mirror the opinion of supporters.

Crucially, it uses the laws of the game and how the Premier League expects its games to be refereed as the barometer.

Still, six on-field mistakes - plus the Thiago red card - is clearly a high number.

And fans struggle to understand why it seems to be OK to have these on-field errors, and not correct them due to the high bar.

articles.summary: El jugador llegó a un acuerdo con el club en octubre para alargar su vínculo hasta 2030
articles.body: Ya hay fecha para que Xavi Espart rubrique su nuevo contrato con el Barcelona. El canterano firmará su renovación este viernes 20 de noviembre en las oficinas del Spotify Camp Nou, en un acto en el que estará acompañado por el presidente Joan Laporta. El futbolista ampliará su vinculación con la entidad azulgrana hasta 2030. El pasado 8 de octubre, el club anunció oficialmente que había alcanzado un acuerdo con el jugador para prolongar su contrato. Sin embargo, ya avisaron que la firma se demoraría unos días y finalmente tendrá lugar este viernes. De este modo, el Barcelona garantiza la continuidad de uno de los jóvenes talentos surgidos de La Masia. Xavi Espart, que actualmente se encuentra en la enfermería debido a una lesión de sindesmosis en el tobillo derecho sufrida durante el Clásico, llegó al fútbol base culé en el verano de 2015 y debutó con el primer equipo en marzo de 2026. No obstante, su verdadera consolidación llegó esta temporada, cuando sus buenas actuaciones durante el verano convencieron al cuerpo técnico. De esta forma, el pasado mes de agosto recibió ficha del primer equipo. Desde entonces, el defensa catalán ha ido ganando protagonismo en los planes del entrenador. En lo que va de temporada, ha disputado nueve encuentros oficiales, repartidos entre las distintas competiciones, todos ellos como titular. Además, ha contribuido al apartado ofensivo con dos goles y dos asistencias. Sin embargo, sus buenos números se han visto frenados por la lesión sufrida contra el Real Madrid. De momento, se ha perdido los últimos tres encuentros.

articles.title: Nations League: Israel row a 'defining moment for us' - Republic of Ireland boss Hallgrimsson
articles.summary: Republic of Ireland manager Heimir Hallgrimsson says the controversy surrounding the Nations League games against Israel has made "this group stronger".
articles.body:
Republic of Ireland manager Heimir Hallgrimsson says the controversy surrounding the Nations League games against Israel has made "this group stronger".

The players took a vote on whether to play the two matches - in September and October - amid protests over the Israel-Gaza war , with goalkeeper Gavin Bazunu making himself unavailable for selection.

The Republic of Ireland won the first match 3-0 in Hungary before a 1-1 draw in Serbia.

Hallgrimsson was speaking after his side defeated 10-man Kosovo 3-0 in Dublin on Tuesday night to finish runners-up to Austria in Group B3.

The second place means the Republic of Ireland will be in pot two for the Euro 2028 qualifying draw next month and also ensures they have a promotion/relegation play-off in March against a League A team as they try to move up to the top tier for the first time.

"It tested everyone - physically, mentally and no I've learned a lot doubt and the players have learned a lot and grown," said Hallgrimsson.

"I am pretty sure in one year, two years when this team becomes successful we will look back and say that was the defining moment for us.

"I am pretty sure we will look back in hindsight and say this was a huge moment for us.

"Us as leaders sometimes artificially create us against the world to get the group to stick together and I have said we have got that environment for free for two or three weeks and we survived it and it made this team and this group stronger."

Republic of Ireland seal second with win over 10-man Kosovo

Talisman Parrott caps dream year with two more goals

Republic of Ireland denied by Israel in draw

Troy Parrott scored two penalties and Jack Moylan also netted against a Kosovo team hit by the dismissal of Kreshnik Hajrizi after 26 minutes.

It brought to an end a campaign which saw the Republic of Ireland win two matches, with two drawn and two lost.

"We know we will never be perfect and we are trying to find a way to win with what we have," Hallgrimsson added.

"I think we are getting better and better on that. Like I said in the first meeting when I was here and was introduced, I said I want to build a team that is difficult to play against and I feel like we are getting closer and closer to that.

"We are now consistent in our selection of players. We've more or less found our squad, our group and with doing that on a consistent basis, playing the same players together, playing the same system, the connections between players are starting to emerge."

The promotion/relegation play-off draw take place on Friday with the Republic set to go up against one of Croatia, Serbia, Denmark or Wales.

"Everybody, and especially us, like to play the top teams. For one, to compare yourself with the best teams, that's one thing," he said.

"Second, those teams will expose your weaknesses and that helps you in your growth to play these teams and they will expose your weaknesses so we can continue our growth. We're already looking forward to March.

"[There are] exciting teams in the pot. Whoever we draw, it's going to be two tough games and it's good for this team at this time to play these matches instead of friendlies, for example.

"So we're really excited for March and looking forward to meeting the players again."

Tanto a García Plaza como a Pellegrini les han faltado jugadores y apenas contarán con una o dos sesiones para trabajar con todos los efectivos disponibles. En cuanto a la clasificación, el Betis ocupa la cuarta plaza, mientras que el Sevilla es sexto. Aunque ya se sabe que en un derbi no hay favoritos.

articles.title: Antonio Adán anuncia su retirada
articles.standfirst: Canteran del Madrid, jugó en Cagliari, Betis, Atlético de Madrid, Sporting de Lisboa y Esteghlal
articles.summary: Canteran del Madrid, jugó en Cagliari, Betis, Atlético de Madrid, Sporting de Lisboa y Esteghlal
articles.body: Antonio Adán, que militó en la cantera del Real Madrid, en el primer equipo blanco, en el Cagliari, Betis, Atlético de Madrid, Sporting de Lisboa y Esteghlal, ha anunciado su retirada del fútbol en activo. "Despues de pensarlo mucho quiero anunciar que dejo el fútbol profesional", afirmó en un vídeo publicado en sus redes en el que repasa su carrera, que ahora pone fin a los 39 años, y en la que, además de en los citados clubes, jugó en las selecciones inferiores. "He tenido la suerte de vivir todo lo que soñaba cuando era niño. He ganado, he perdido, he llorado, y he celebrado, y, sobre todo, he aprendido. Gracias a todos los que me dieron la oportunidad, a todos los compañeros que caminaron conmigo, a los entrenadores que me enseñaron, a los clubes que fueron mi casa y a mi familia por estar siempre", apuntó el madrileño. "El fútbol me lo ha dado todo y, aunque ya no podré escuchar esos sonidos (los que le han acompañado en su trayectoria: el balón cuando golpea el palo, una parada, el público, el vestuario antes de salir al campo y el silencio antes del pitido inicial), tengo claro que se quedarán grabados en mi memoria. Gracias futbol. Ha sido un privilegio", concluye en su adiós. Tras debutar en 2010 con el primer equipo del Real Madrid tras despuntar en la cantera, en diciembre de 2012 se vio inmerso sin quererlo en la polémica suplencia que le otorgó Jose Mourinho a Iker Casillas y que le dio a él la titularidad, que luego fue para Diego López. En septiembre de 2013 definitivamente optó por la salida del Real Madrid en busca de minutos. Recaló en el Cagliari, del que en enero de 2014 se marchó al Betis. El Atlético de Madrid fue su siguiente destino en 2018 y, en agosto de 2020, fichó por el Sporting lisboeta, en el que estuvo hasta junio de 2024. Un año después, en agosto de 2025, se incorporó al Esteghlal iraní, con el que firmó por un año.

articles.title: New Portugal No. 7 says he felt no 'extra weight' wearing iconic shirt after scoring first international goal in post-Ronaldo era
articles.summary: Carlos Forbs marks a historic moment for Portugal, scoring his first international goal while donning the No. 7 jersey previously worn by Cristiano Ronaldo, as the team seeks to redefine itself after his retirement.
articles.body: Cristiano Ronaldo’s place in Portuguese football cannot be handed over with a shirt number, and Portugal have made a point of acknowledging that distinction. Their redesigned No. 7 carries a line through the digit, a small alteration intended to preserve the original number as part of Ronaldo’s legacy. Carlos Forbs has been given the shirt for now, and against Wales he supplied something more useful than symbolism: his first international goal, which secured Portugal’s first victory since Ronaldo announced his retirement from the national team.A new No. 7, and a first goal for PortugalForbs scored the decisive goal in Portugal’s 3-2 Nations League victory over Wales in Cardiff on Tuesday, November 17, giving the national team a result it needed after the disappointment of losing 4-1 to Denmark three days earlier. The 22-year-old winger came off the bench in the 59th-minute and found the net in the 70th minute, delivering his first goal in only his third senior international appearance.The moment carried an obvious significance because Forbs was wearing the No. 7 shirt that Ronaldo had made his own over nearly two decades with Portugal. The Portuguese Football Federation has introduced a modified design, with a line running through the number, as a way of distinguishing the new shirt from the one associated with the former captain. The number cannot simply be retired from international football, where squad numbers must be assigned for major tournaments, but the alteration gives Portugal a way to acknowledge the player who wore it for so long.Forbs had worn the No. 7 in a World Cup qualifying match against Armenia last year, when Ronaldo was suspended. The redesigned version of the shirt made its first appearance in the post-Ronaldo period against Denmark on November 14, when Forbs came on as a substitute in the 64th minute. Portugal lost that match 4-1, making the Wales fixture the first opportunity for the new wearer of the number to be associated with a victory.His goal in Cardiff came at a moment when Portugal needed to regain control of a match that had become increasingly open. Fernandes played the ball forward, and a defensive error from Wales allowed Forbs to move into the area, where he finished low past the goalkeeper.“It's a special feeling; I won't forget today,” Forbs said after the match. “The most important thing is that we managed to win; I'm happy about that.”He also explained that the goal helped Portugal settle after a difficult spell in the game. “We needed the goal to calm the game down, and it just so happened that I scored.”Forbs was careful not to make the occasion about the number alone. “I know it's a number with special significance, but I didn't feel any extra weight wearing it,” he said.For a player still establishing himself at international level, that was a measured response to the attention surrounding his new shirt. His immediate priority is to build on the opportunity, earn further appearances under the Portugal coach and establish himself through his performances rather than the comparisons that inevitably come with wearing Ronaldo’s number.Who is Carlos Forbs? From Sporting and Manchester City to Club BruggeForbs was born Carlos Roberto Forbs Borges in Sintra, Portugal, on March 19, 2004, and has Bissau-Guinean roots through his family. He began his football development in Portugal, including a spell in Sporting CP's academy, before moving to England with his family in 2014, when he was 10 years old. Manchester City brought him into their youth system, where he spent several years developing as a winger known for his pace, direct running and ability to create chances.At City, he progressed through the youth teams without making a senior appearance for the first team. His performances at under-18 and under-21 level, however, attracted considerable attention. In the 2022-23 season, he became one of the standout players in Premier League 2, scoring regularly and helping City's under-21 side win the competition. He was also named the league's player of the season.His move to Ajax in August 2023 gave him his first opportunity in senior club football. The Dutch club signed him from Manchester City for an initial fee of €14 million, with performance-related additions potentially taking the deal to €19 million. It was around this period that he began using Forbs, his mother's surname, rather than Borges, the name under which he had been known during his time in City's academy.He made his professional debut for Ajax in August 2023 and went on to score his first senior club goal against Marseille in the Europa League in September that year. His time in the Netherlands was followed by a loan move to Wolverhampton Wanderers for the 2024-25 season, giving him another opportunity to develop in English football.In July 2025, he joined Belgian club Club Brugge, where he has continued his development. The move has put him in a competitive environment in which he can gain regular experience, while his performances have kept him in contention for Portugal. He is still at an early stage of his senior international career, with all three of his appearances for the national team coming as a substitute.Portugal's first win after Ronaldo, and the road through WalesPortugal's victory was not a straightforward demonstration of a team already comfortable without Ronaldo. The match in Cardiff exposed defensive problems and moments of indiscipline, but it also showed the side's ability to respond when the game moved away from them.Bruno Fernandes opened the scoring in the 11th minute with a curling finish into the top corner, after João Neves won possession in midfield. Wales equalised two minutes later through David Brooks, who finished after Diogo Costa had initially saved Harry Wilson's effort. The hosts then took the lead in the 40th minute when Sorba Thomas completed a counter-attack, putting Portugal under pressure just before half-time.Pedro Neto restored parity three minutes later, finishing at the far post after Francisco Trincão delivered from the left. The teams went into the interval at 2-2, with Portugal having recovered quickly from conceding twice. Forbs then supplied the winning goal in the second half, putting the visitors ahead in the 70th minute.The match became more complicated when Neto was sent off in the 74th minute after receiving two yellow cards within a short period. Portugal had to defend their advantage with 10 players for the closing stages, but Wales struggled to make the numerical advantage count and the visitors held on.The result was important in the group standings as well as in the immediate aftermath of Ronaldo's departure. Portugal finished top of Nations League Group A4 with 15 points, having won five of their six matches. They will face a runner-up from another group in the quarter-finals in March 2027, with the draw scheduled for November 20.The wider transition had begun before the defeat to Denmark. Ronaldo's last appearance for Portugal came in September, when they beat Wales 1-0. He was subsequently an unused substitute against Norway, left the squad amid tensions surrounding his situation, and announced his international retirement on November 5. He ended his Portugal career with 234 appearances and 146 goals, both men's international records.The Denmark defeat was Portugal's first match after that announcement, and the loss brought renewed attention to what the team would look like without a player who had been central to its identity for so long. The Wales victory did not resolve every question. Portugal still looked vulnerable defensively, and Neto's dismissal nearly gave the hosts an opportunity to force another equaliser. But the team responded to setbacks, secured the result and finished the group in first place.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.
